name: gofront
author: Luuk van Venrooij
description: A Go-inspired language that transpiles to JavaScript

scripts.build:all: npm run build:simple && npm run build:reactive && npm run build:gom && npm run build:templ
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:examples && npm run test:examples:dom && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:examples: node src/index.js test example/simple/src && node src/index.js test example/simple/src/utils && node src/index.js test example/reactive/src && node src/index.js test example/reactive/src/utils && node src/index.js test example/gom/src && node src/index.js test example/gom/src/utils && node src/index.js test example/templ/src && node src/index.js test example/templ/src/utils
scripts.test:examples:dom: node src/index.js test --dom example/simple/src && node src/index.js test --dom example/gom/src && node src/index.js test --dom example/templ/src
scripts.check: biome check . && sentrux check && sentrux gate && node src/index.js example/simple/src --check && node src/index.js example/reactive/src --check && node src/index.js example/gom/src --check && node src/index.js example/templ/src --check
